name: huber_512_1_eulerian_cradle
_source: Huber Eulerwiege 512.1, 'Phibox + Z-Verst. ohne Gegenlager', drawing 202401 / Teilestamm-ID 45166, revision C.

_provenance.geometry: REAL. Huber STEP, converted by tools/cad/convert_step.sh.
_provenance.total_mass_kg: REAL. The drawing states Ft.-Gew. 80 kg.
_provenance.frame: REAL, measured. The CAD is Y-UP: the BASE body's Y extent is 0.579 m and the drawing's overall height is 581.5 mm. The instrument calls its vertical travel 'Z' while the CAD's vertical axis is Y, which is why the body named Z is elongated in Y.
_provenance.pivots: MEASURED from world bounds of each body (tools/cad/usd_structure.py).
_provenance.axes: INFERRED from the drawing and the body extents. The chi ring spans X and Y equally and stands vertical, so chi rotates about Z. Check against the model before trusting it.
_provenance.mass_split: ESTIMATED. Only the 80 kg total is known; the split across bodies is a guess weighted by size.
_provenance.limits: ESTIMATED. 'ohne Gegenlager' (no counter-bearing) implies a restricted chi range; the drawing annotates 120 deg in the plan view. Z travel is a guess.
_provenance.drive_gains: ESTIMATED. Stiffness and damping are not derivable from a drawing. They determine the steady-state error, so the retry deadbands MUST be measured on the running model -- see docs/byo-model.md.
_provenance.pv_bindings: DECLARED. Each joint names the PV it expects to be driven by, authored onto the joint prim as epics:motorPV. The adapter checks its own config against these on the first frame, so the model and the config cannot silently disagree.

joints.name: chi_axis
joints._units: degrees, as UsdPhysics requires for revolute limits and drive targets

joints.name: z_axis
joints._units: metres for prismatic limits and drive targets
